extraction.name: ScienceQA
extraction.description: A new benchmark that consists of 21k multimodal multiple choice questions with diverse science topics and annotations of their answers with corresponding lectures and explanations.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan
extraction.citeAs: Lu, P., Mishra, S., Xia, T., Qiu, L., Chang, K.-W., Zhu, S.-C., Tafjord, O., Clark, P., & Kalyan, A. (2022). Learn to Explain: Multimodal Reasoning via Thought Chains for Science Question Answering. NeurIPS.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Questions are sourced from open resources managed by IXL Learning, an online learning platform curated by experts in the field of K-12 education. The original science problems were downloaded and individual components (e.g., questions, hints, images, options, answers, lectures, and solutions) were extracted based on heuristic rules.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: 83.9% of the questions are annotated with a lecture, while 90.5% of the questions feature an explanation. 33.9% of questions have no context.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Shuffled the answer options of each question to ensure the choices do not follow any specific pattern.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Manually removed invalid questions (e.g., questions with only one choice, faulty data, or duplicates). Used semi-automated scripts to reformat the lectures and solutions so that special structures in the texts, such as tables and lists, are easily distinguishable. Incorrect annotations were further manually revised by experts.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations (lectures and explanations) were extracted from the source data using heuristic rules and then manually revised by experts to ensure data quality.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset does not contain any user usage data or personally sensitive information such as gender and race.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Provides a useful benchmark for multi-modal learning, multi-hop reasoning, and general artificial intelligence. Contributes to the development of K-12 education applications such as tutoring systems.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The authors state that after careful examination, they have not found any improper content, such as pornographic information, racial remarks, or harmful social bias. The data aligns with California Common Core Content Standards.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Image captions generated for the dataset lack fine-grained semantics and usually do not work well for diagrams. Models struggle with questions requiring understanding of complex and uncommon domain knowledge.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking multimodal learning, multi-hop reasoning, and general AI. Training, Validation, Testing. K-12 education applications.
